# Discovery-to-Proposal Pre-Sales Engineering Engine Plugin ### Global Multi-Agent Pre-Sales Engineering Pipeline for Google Antigravity [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Enterprise-grade staged multi-agent pipeline with contextual handoff (DAG) that ingests raw client discovery notes, meeting transcripts, and project briefings to engineer an exhaustive, dense, analytical technical-commercial pre-proposal dossier (DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md). Strictly prohibits slide decks or superficial summaries, orchestrating Stage 1 Problem & Scope Alignment, Stage 2 Solutions Architecture & Technical Risk Audit, Stage 3 Engineering Estimation (T-Shirt & Analogy), Stage 4 Agile Staffing & Milestone Scheduling, Stage 5 Commercial Governance & Contractual Risk Mitigation, led by the Lead Pre-Sales Orchestrator.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin ``` --- ## 1. Overview & Core Mission The **Discovery-to-Proposal Engine Plugin** (`discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin`) is an enterprise-grade agentic customization for Google Antigravity. It orchestrates a specialized multi-agent engineering team through a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with contextual handoffs to perform end-to-end pre-sales engineering for custom software development engagements. When a sales engineer or solutions architect inputs messy discovery notes or a meeting transcript, this plugin does **NOT** generate a superficial slide deck or sales pitch. Instead, it systematically interrogates business drivers, audits legacy technical dependencies, sizes effort through calibrated T-shirt analogy, dimensions realistic delivery squads with an uncompromised 75-80% utilization factor, mitigates contractual exposure through tacit acceptance terms, and compiles a comprehensive technical source of truth. --- --- ## 2. Critical Negative Constraint: Zero-Slides Tolerance > [!CAUTION] > **STRICT PROHIBITION OF SLIDES & PRESENTATION FORMATS** > This plugin and all constituent agents are **strictly forbidden** from generating PowerPoint/Keynote slides, pitch decks, summary presentation bullets, or abridged outlines (e.g., *"Slide 1: Problem"*, *"Slide 2: Solution"*). > The sole authorized primary artifact is a dense, analytical, technical-commercial Markdown dossier titled `DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md`. --- --- ## 3. Pipeline Architecture (DAG) The pipeline executes as a deterministic 5-stage Directed Acyclic Graph with contextual handoffs: ```mermaid flowchart TD RAW["Raw Discovery Notes / Meeting Transcript / Briefing"] --> S1["Stage 1: Problem & Scope Alignment Analyst"] S1 -->|"Handoff 1: Scope Baseline"| S2["Stage 2: Principal Solutions Architect & Risk Auditor"] S1 --> S3 S2 -->|"Handoff 2: Tech Foundation & Risks"| S3["Stage 3: Engineering Estimator (Analogy & Sizing)"] S1 --> S4 S2 --> S4 S3 -->|"Handoff 3: Effort Model"| S4["Stage 4: Agile Delivery & Staffing Specialist"] S1 --> S5 S2 --> S5 S3 --> S5 S4 -->|"Handoff 4: Delivery Plan"| S5["Stage 5: Commercial Governance & Risk Mitigator"] S1 --> ORCH S2 --> ORCH S3 --> ORCH S4 --> ORCH S5 -->|"Handoff 5: Commercial Strategy"| ORCH["Lead Pre-Sales Orchestrator & Synthesizer"] ORCH -->|"Automated Validation (validate_dossier.py)"| DOSSIER["DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md"] ``` --- --- ## 4. Specialized Agent Team | Stage | Agent Persona | Key Focus & Non-Negotiable Output | | :---: | :--- | :--- | | **Stage 0** | **Lead Pre-Sales Orchestrator**
`stage0-pre-sales-orchestrator-agent` | Root parent agent and master synthesizer. Controls DAG flow, enforces anti-hallucination policies, aggregates partial handoffs, and compiles `DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md`. | | **Stage 1** | **Problem & Scope Alignment Analyst**
`stage1-problem-scope-alignment-agent` | Extracts real business pain (5 Whys), establishes quantifiable KPIs/metrics, and builds the ironclad **Delimitation Matrix: Core In-Scope vs. Explicit Out-of-Scope**. Emits `Handoff 1`. | | **Stage 2** | **Principal Solutions Architect & Risk Auditor**
`stage2-solutions-architect-risk-agent` | Audits Technical Red Flags (legacy ERPs, undocumented APIs, LGPD/security NFRs), designs macro architecture topology, and renders a formal verdict on **Phase 0 Technical Inception**. Emits `Handoff 2`. | | **Stage 3** | **Engineering Estimator (Analogy & Sizing)**
`stage3-engineering-estimator-agent` | Decomposes scope into 5 to 8 functional macro-epics, applies T-shirt sizing (S, M, L, XL), computes 3-point PERT ranges, and factors in explicit uncertainty risk buffers (+20% to +40%). Emits `Handoff 3`. | | **Stage 4** | **Agile Delivery & Staffing Specialist**
`stage4-agile-delivery-staffing-agent` | Sizes the engineering squad (Tech Lead, Senior/Mid Devs, QA/SDET, UX, PM) with strict **75-80% effective utilization** (30-32 productive hrs/wk) and structures milestones (M0-M4). Emits `Handoff 4`. | | **Stage 5** | **Commercial Governance & Risk Mitigator**
`stage5-commercial-governance-risk-agent` | Evaluates engagement models (Dedicated Squad, T&M, Fixed Scope), establishes Change Request (CR) thresholds, and drafts client UAT SLAs with a **5-day Tacit Acceptance Clause**. Emits `Handoff 5`. | --- --- ## 5. Specification of the Final Dossier (`DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md`) The orchestrator compiles a single, exhaustive Markdown dossier structured into 8 mandatory chapters: 1. **Capítulo 1: Resumo Executivo do Problema & Objetivos de Negócio** Organizational context, root operational pains, quantifiable target metrics (KPIs/OKRs), and fundamental business constraints. 2. **Capítulo 2: Matriz de Delimitação: Escopo Contemplado vs. Não-Escopo Explícito** Granular delimitation matrix separating mandatory in-scope items from explicit exclusions, with anti-scope-creep rationale. 3. **Capítulo 3: Relatório de Arquitetura Macro, Integrações Críticas & Red Flags Técnicas** Component topology, modern technology stack, legacy integration audit (ERPs, APIs), Red Flag matrix, and formal **Phase 0 Technical Inception verdict**. 4. **Capítulo 4: Decomposição em Macro-Épicos e Estimativa por Analogia (T-Shirt Sizing)** Decomposition into 5 to 8 macro-epics, T-shirt sizing (S, M, L, XL), three-point PERT effort, and calibrated uncertainty risk buffers (+20% to +40%). 5. **Capítulo 5: Plano de Staffing (Composição da Squad, Senioridade e Carga Horária)** Squad topology (Tech Lead, Devs, QA, UX, PM), seniority mix, and velocity calibration based on **75% to 80% effective utilization**. 6. **Capítulo 6: Cronograma Macro por Marcos de Entrega (Milestones)** Chronological delivery milestones (M0 Inception, M1 Core MVP, M2 Integrations, M3 Hardening/UAT, M4 Go-Live & Hypercare) with concrete exit criteria. 7. **Capítulo 7: Diretrizes de Governança, Homologação e Mitigação de Riscos Contratuais** Change Request (CR) protocol, 5-business-day client UAT window, ironclad **Tacit Acceptance Clause (Cláusula de Aceite Tácito)**, and RACI matrix. 8. **Capítulo 8: Recomendação de Modelo Comercial & Estratégia de Precificação (Memória de Apoio)** Comparative contract model evaluation (Dedicated Squad vs. T&M vs. Fixed Scope), recommended commercial structure, gross project hours, and margin contingency reserve. --- --- ## 8. Usage & Triggering the Pipeline Simply invoke Antigravity with your raw discovery notes or meeting transcript: ### Trigger Example 1: Full Pipeline from Raw Notes ```text Run the discovery-to-proposal pipeline on these client meeting notes to generate DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md: Client: Distribuidora Nacional de Autopeças (150 filial stores) Problem: Currently orders take 48h to sync between stores and the central TOTVS Protheus ERP. The store managers use Excel sheets, causing 7% duplicate stock reservations. They want a web portal where store managers can browse inventory, place emergency stock transfers, and see delivery status. They also asked for an AI recommendation chatbot and native iPhone app. Their TOTVS runs on-premise on Microsoft SQL Server with SOAP Web Services, but IT has no test environment. Target launch is in 4 months. ``` ### Trigger Example 2: Ingesting an Interview Transcript ```text Ingest this discovery transcript and execute the 5-stage pre-sales engineering DAG with contextual handoff. [Paste Zoom/Teams transcription text here] ``` --- --- ## 9. Automated Dossier Validation To ensure generated dossiers strictly adhere to all 8 chapters, contain zero forbidden slide patterns, enforce 75-80% utilization, and include tacit acceptance clauses, run the built-in audit script: ```bash python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin/skills/discovery-proposal-orchestrator/scripts/validate_dossier.py path/to/DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md ``` **Verification Output:** ```text ================================================================= 🔍 AUDITING PRE-PROPOSAL TECHNICAL DOSSIER 📄 File: DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md 📊 Total Lines: 228 | Total Words: 2421 ================================================================= ✅ PASS: Analytical density verified (2421 words). ✅ PASS: Strict Anti-Slide verification passed (0 slide/deck markers found). --- Auditing 8 Mandatory Chapters --- ✅ Chapter 1: Executive Summary & Problem Statement present. ✅ Chapter 2: Delimitation Matrix: In-Scope vs Explicit Out-of-Scope present. ✅ Chapter 3: Macro Architecture, Critical Integrations & Technical Red Flags present. ✅ Chapter 4: Decomposition into Macro-Epics & Analogy Estimation (T-Shirt Sizing) present. ✅ Chapter 5: Staffing Plan & Squad Topology (75-80% Utilization) present. ✅ Chapter 6: Macro Schedule by Delivery Milestones (M0 - M4) present. ✅ Chapter 7: Governance Guidelines, UAT/Homologation & Tacit Acceptance present. ✅ Chapter 8: Commercial Model Recommendation & Pricing Support Memory present. --- Auditing Mandatory Technical & Governance Safeguards --- ✅ Concept verified: Delimitation Matrix Table ✅ Concept verified: Technical Red Flags Analysis ✅ Concept verified: Phase 0 (Inception) Formal Verdict ✅ Concept verified: T-Shirt Sizing Application ✅ Concept verified: Utilization Factor (75-80%) ✅ Concept verified: Delivery Milestones (M0 to M4) ✅ Concept verified: Tacit Acceptance Clause (Aceite Tácito) ✅ Concept verified: 5 Business Days Homologation SLA ✅ Concept verified: Change Request (CR) Protocol ✅ Epic Count verified: 6 distinct macro-epics detected. ================================================================= 🎯 FINAL VERDICT: PASS! All pre-sales engineering guardrails verified. ================================================================= ``` --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`discovery-to-proposal-engine-rules.md`](rules/discovery-to-proposal-engine-rules.md)**: >- ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/discovery-proposal-orchestrator`](skills/discovery-proposal-orchestrator/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to orchestrate the end-to-end multi-agent pre-sales engineering pipeline from raw discovery notes, meeting transcripts, or client briefs into a comprehensive technical-commercial pre-proposal dossier (DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md). Strictly enforces the 5-stage DAG with contextual handoff, anti-hallucination protocols, and zero slide generation. - **[`/stage1-problem-scope-alignment`](skills/stage1-problem-scope-alignment/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to extract root business pains, define measurable business KPIs, and establish an ironclad Delimitation Matrix (Core In-Scope vs. Explicit Out-of-Scope) from raw discovery notes or transcripts. - **[`/stage2-tech-architecture-risk`](skills/stage2-tech-architecture-risk/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to audit technical red flags (legacy ERPs, undocumented APIs, data security/LGPD), define the macro architecture topology, and evaluate the necessity of a Phase 0 (Technical Inception). - **[`/stage3-macro-engineering-estimator`](skills/stage3-macro-engineering-estimator/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to decompose In-Scope requirements into 5 to 8 functional macro-epics, apply analogy and T-shirt sizing (S, M, L, XL), and calculate 3-point PERT effort with explicit uncertainty risk buffers (+20% to +40%). - **[`/stage4-squad-allocation-milestones`](skills/stage4-squad-allocation-milestones/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to design the optimal engineering squad topology, apply an uncompromised 75-80% effective utilization factor, and structure delivery into tangible Milestones (M0 to M4). - **[`/stage5-commercial-governance-risk`](skills/stage5-commercial-governance-risk/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill to formulate commercial contracting recommendations, define the Change Request (CR) governance protocol, and establish client UAT homologation SLAs with an ironclad Tacit Acceptance clause. ### Specialized Subagents (`agents/`) Autonomous personas delegated for in-depth execution: - **[`stage0_pre_sales_orchestrator_agent`](agents/stage0_pre_sales_orchestrator_agent.md)**: Lead Pre-Sales Orchestrator and Master Integrator. Coordinates the multi-agent DAG pipeline from raw discovery notes to the final unified analytical dossier (DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md), enforces anti-hallucination and anti-slide rules, and manages sequential stage handoffs. - **[`stage1_problem_scope_alignment_agent`](agents/stage1_problem_scope_alignment_agent.md)**: Problem & Scope Alignment Analyst. Ingests raw discovery notes, extracts root business pains versus feature wishlists, identifies measurable business KPIs, and establishes an ironclad In-Scope vs Explicit Out-of-Scope delimitation matrix. - **[`stage2_solutions_architect_risk_agent`](agents/stage2_solutions_architect_risk_agent.md)**: Principal Solutions Architect & Risk Auditor. Evaluates Handoff 1 Scope Baseline, audits technical red flags (legacy ERPs, undocumented APIs, data security/LGPD), defines macro architectural topology, and delivers an authoritative verdict on Phase 0 Technical Inception needs. - **[`stage3_engineering_estimator_agent`](agents/stage3_engineering_estimator_agent.md)**: Engineering Estimator (Analogy & T-Shirt Sizing). Decomposes In-Scope requirements into 5-8 functional macro-epics, applies calibrated analogy and T-shirt sizing, calculates sprint/week effort ranges, and factors in explicit uncertainty risk buffers based on technical debt and architectural red flags. - **[`stage4_agile_delivery_staffing_agent`](agents/stage4_agile_delivery_staffing_agent.md)**: Agile Delivery & Staffing Specialist. Converts Handoff 3 Effort Model into an optimal engineering squad topology with seniority mixes, enforces strict 75-80% utilization factors, and designs a phased macro schedule structured around clear delivery milestones. - **[`stage5_commercial_governance_risk_agent`](agents/stage5_commercial_governance_risk_agent.md)**: Commercial Governance & Risk Mitigator. Formulates contract model recommendations, establishes Change Request (CR) thresholds, specifies client UAT homologation SLAs with an ironclad tacit acceptance clause, and details commercial risk mitigation and pricing rationale. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── discovery-to-proposal-engine-rules.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── discovery-proposal-orchestrator/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── stage1-problem-scope-alignment/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── stage2-tech-architecture-risk/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── stage3-macro-engineering-estimator/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── stage4-squad-allocation-milestones/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── stage5-commercial-governance-risk/ │ └── SKILL.md └── agents/ # Specialized autonomous subagents └── stage0_pre_sales_orchestrator_agent.md └── stage1_problem_scope_alignment_agent.md └── stage2_solutions_architect_risk_agent.md └── stage3_engineering_estimator_agent.md └── stage4_agile_delivery_staffing_agent.md └── stage5_commercial_governance_risk_agent.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown -
